holding_cards.about: Holding cards (track PB, design handover/design/SSE4-playbook-and-switchboard-design.md 6.2 and 6.3): the one line of words a held screen shows. Plain cards say what is happening; jokes are drawn at random, never the same one twice running. A later pack adds cards, or replaces a kind with "replace": ["joke"] so a setting's screens speak in its own voice. All original: none quotes a film, a book or a game. The first joke is Alex's.
